title: Omg, it worked!
text:
Omg, it worked!. This was so easy!

Bought a gallon of milk (not ULTRA pasteurized) and decided to give it a try.

Literally 40 mins later, my cheese log is cooling. Forty minutes. My first time. Cheese making rookie here.

Highly recommend for fellow novices. Instructions clear, everything you need (besides milk) is in that box.

Game changer. So long $6 half pound logs of fresh mozzarella from the grocery store. I'm making my own!

product_metadata.title: Mozzarella and Ricotta Cheese Making Kit
features: This kit includes 3-ounce citric acid, 3-ounce cheese salt, 5 tablets of vegetable rennet, 1 yard butter muslin, a thermometer, and a recipe booklet.
With this kit you can make mozzarella cheese in just 30 minutes
Everything included except for the milk
Great fun for the entire Family and your friends will love it too
With this kit you can make 20 one pound batches of cheese
description: With this kit you can make Mozzarella Cheese in just 30 minutes. Everything included except for the milk! Great fun for the entire Family, your friends will love it too! As a bonus our booklet teaches you to make a delicious, rich & creamy Ricotta cheese too. Enough ingredients to make approximately 20 one pound batches of cheese.
